planned_by: Claude (Critic): owner — evolve the user's result round by round
goal:
T66 — prompt Arena follow-ups (owner: type at the bottom and watch the result evolve round after round). Builds on
T64 (services/api/evoforge/arena_prompt.py). API only.
- POST /v1/arena/{id}/followup {prompt: 1..2000 chars (else 422), feedback?, single_apply? (default: the parent's)} ->
  202 {arena_id}. Unknown id -> 404; parent not a finished prompt arena -> 409. Budget guard as in T64 (-> 402).
- Each finished prompt arena must keep, server-side only: each lane's final files (the template or parent files plus
  that lane's final applied candidate; unchanged files when nothing applied) and its full acceptance suite. Store them
  in a private record (evidence store kind "arena_private", keyed by arena id) that GET endpoints never return.
- The follow-up round: each lane starts from ITS OWN final files of the parent (single from single's, evoforge from
  evoforge's) and gets the task goal = the follow-up prompt plus the same implementation instruction (mention the
  earlier requests as context, but the follow-up prompt text must appear verbatim). The judge Critic is called with a
  goal built from the prompts only (earlier requests as context + the new request; never file contents) to write
  tests for the NEW request; keep entries via sealed_eval._critic_suite_from_output(out, ["app"]); drop new tests that
  pass on BOTH lanes' starting files. The round's acceptance suite = the parent's full suite + the kept new tests.
  Both lanes are scored on it (same machinery as T64, previews included). Fewer than 3 tests -> unscorable.
- Document: like T64 plus parent_id, root_id, round_index (root = 1, follow-up = parent + 1); manifest adds
  acceptance_inherited, acceptance_new, acceptance_dropped (new tests dropped), acceptance_count (inherited + new).
  Judge names and code never appear in any response or lane goal (scrub as T64 does).
- GET /v1/arena/{id}/chain -> {rounds: [docs from the root to the newest round of that chain, in round order]} for
  any member id of the chain (404 unknown). Root arenas get root_id = own id, round_index 1, parent_id null.
- Proxy: allow POST /v1/arena/<id>/followup and GET /v1/arena/<id>/chain (proxyPolicy.ts + cases).
Tests: services/api/tests/test_muse_t66.py.
